meta.origin: Measured tier: Yahoo Finance batch spark endpoint (v7/finance/spark, range=1y&interval=1d). Index tier: the SEC company_tickers_exchange.json listed-issuer file.
meta.note: Offline starting point, NOT a quote. Every ticker, fund and company name here is real. Prices, trailing yields, volatility and the movementStats block are approximate round figures for 2026-08-01, hand-set to be plainly reasonable rather than precise. movementStats has exactly the shape core/movement.js analyse() returns, so the setup, heat and expected-move band shown offline are computed by the same code that runs on refresh. Classification, mutual-fund minimums and access notes come from MEASURED_UNIVERSE in src/sources/equities.js, not from this file.

fields.symbol: ticker; must exist in the adapter MEASURED_UNIVERSE or the row is skipped
fields.price: share or NAV price in USD; also the minimum investment unless the fund sets one
fields.trailingYield: sum of the last 12 months of distributions over price, percent. 0 means it genuinely pays nothing
fields.maxDrawdown: deepest peak-to-trough fall over the window, percent — a risk input
fields.movementStats: precomputed chart read: vol, regime{recent,baseline,ratio}, rangePos, drawdown, trend, volumeRatio, lastClose, bars

meta.secSampleNote: A 62-row sample of the SEC listed-issuer file in the shape that endpoint publishes, so the two-tier UI has unmeasured rows to render offline. These carry identity only — no price, no rate, nothing measured. CIK is present only where it can be stated exactly; the live file always carries one. Live, this tier covers about 10,000 issuers.
